skills.name: Spirit Affinity
skills.description: The blessing of the Fox God increases your Spirit Affinity.

skills.name: Master of Swimming
skills.description: Increases swimming speed and prevents HP loss when swimming.

skills.name: Master of Organization
skills.description: Expands Equip, Use, Set-up, and Etc. Inventory.

skills.name: Master of Organization
skills.description: Expands Equip, Use, Set-up, and Etc. Inventory.

skills.name: Spirit Bond 1
skills.description:
Recovers HP if the attack hits while you are bonded with the spirit.
Permanently increases Knockback Resistance and reduces incoming damage.

skills.name: Close Call
skills.description:
Grants you a chance to survive an attack that would've been fatal.

Level 3: Permanently increases Damage for Shade.

skills.name: Legendary Spirit
skills.description:
[Master Level: 1]
With the aid of a legendary spirit, you can now use scrolls on items that you can't equip.

skills.name: Fox Trot
skills.description:
Teleports you forward to the farthest enemy in range. When no enemies are around, you'll be teleported forward a set distance.
You can teleport while using skills.

skills.name: Heart Grown Fonder
skills.description:
Summons a guardian spirit through the favor of the Fox God. But can the guardian protect you from an absence dearly felt?
Can be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Cosmic Balance
skills.description: The blessings of the heavens and earth envelop you, increasing your Defense, Max HP, and Max MP.

skills.name: Swift Strike
skills.description: You throw a powerful punch against multiple enemies in front.

skills.name: Flash Fist
skills.description: Imbued with the power of the spirits, you strike multiple enemies in front.

skills.name: Fox God's Favor
skills.description:
Call on the blessing of the Fox God to increase your Attack Speed for a set duration.
Permenantly increases your Attack Power and Damage.

skills.name: Vulpes Leap
skills.description:
Allows you to double jump.
Press the up key at the same to move upward.

skills.name: Fox Spirits
skills.description:
The summoned foxes chase down and attack enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection.
Level 10 required to learn Fire Fox Spirit Mastery.

skills.name: Foxy Courage
skills.description: Channel the power of the Fox God to bolster your aptitude for battle.

skills.name: Knuckle Mastery
skills.description: Increases Knuckle Mastery, Final Damage, and Critical Rate.

skills.name: Spirit Bond 2
skills.description: Deepens your bond with the spirits, boosting your Attack Speed, Speed, and Max Speed permanently.

skills.name: Strength Training
skills.description: Permanently increases your STR through hard work and training.

skills.name: Ground Pound
skills.description: Summons a nature spirit to attack multiple enemies in front of you.

skills.name: Blade Imp - Downward Slash
skills.description: Summon a blade spirit, which pulls multiple enemies down in a fierce attack. Some enemies can resist this pull.

skills.name: Blade Imp - Forward Slash
skills.description: Summon a blade spirit, which pulls in multiple enemies in front of you in a fierce attack. Some enemies can resist this pull.

skills.name: Fox Spirits
skills.description:
Grants a chance to summon Fox Spirits when Shade lands direct skill attacks. The foxes chase down and attack enemies. Unaffected by attack reflection. Targets the boss with the highest HP first.
Can be toggled On/Off

skills.name: Blade Imp - Spin Slash
skills.description: Summon a blade spirit, which pulls multiple nearby enemies toward you in a fierce attack. Some enemies can resist this pull.

skills.name: Blade Imp - Direct
skills.description:
Summon a blade spirit and choose the direction of the Blade Imp's attack.
Press the arrow keys after using the skill to choose Blade Imp - Forward Slash,
Blade Imp - Downward Slash, or Blade Imp - Spin Slash.

skills.name: Back Step
skills.description:
Slides backward quickly. Can be used faster in sequence as it does not cancel the casting animation of another skill.
Also increases Avoidability permanently.
Able to move when using the skill.

skills.name: Shockwave Punch
skills.description: Summons a nature spirit to attack multiple enemies in front of you.

skills.name: Total Harmony
skills.description: Increases Attack Power, Damage, and Critical Damage by harmonizing with the Spirit Guardian.

skills.name: Spirit Bond 3
skills.description: Your bond with the spirits grows deeper, permanently increasing your Final Damage and Boss Damage.

skills.name: Harmonious Defense
skills.description: The spirits flow harmoniously within you, permanently increasing your Defense, Status Resistance, and Elemental Resistance.

skills.name: Weaken
skills.description: Enlists the aid of enervating spirits to ignore a portion of the enemy's defense. The spirits also have a chance to possess and weaken enemies.

skills.name: Shockwave Punch
skills.description:
Summons a nature spirit to attack multiple enemies in front of you. 
Can be used 2 times in a row.

skills.name: Spirit Frenzy
skills.description:
Opens a path to the spirit world, creating a wall of frenzied spirits.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Spirit Trap
skills.description:
Calls upon binding spirits to immobilize enemies caught in their trap. Enemies who are already stunned will not be affected.
Affected enemies cannot be stunned again by Spirit Trap or other skills for 90 seconds.

skills.name: Summon Other Spirit
skills.description:
Your guardian spirit intercedes when you fall in battle, knocking back enemies and making you temporarily invincible.
Can be resisted by some enemies.
Cooldown applies when the guardian spirit is summoned and is not affected by Cooldown reset.
Can be toggled On/Off.

skills.name: Spirit Redemption
skills.description: When you fall in battle, a guardian spirit revives you, knocking back enemies and making you temporarily invincible. Can be resisted by some monsters.

skills.name: Bomb Punch
skills.description: Summons a nature spirit to attack multiple enemies in front of you.

skills.name: Bomb Punch
skills.description: Summons a nature spirit to attack multiple enemies in front of you.

skills.name: Spirit Ward
skills.description: Calls upon guardian spirits to neutralize enemy magic and protect you from harm. Spirit Ward's passive effect is not affected by cooldown resets.

skills.name: Spirit Frenzy
skills.description:
Opens a path to the spirit world, creating a wall of frenzied spirits.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Skulk Solidarity
skills.description: The Fox God channels her power into you.

skills.name: Heartfelt Communion
skills.description:
Attunes your heart to the spirit world, deepening your communion.
Spirits of greater power begin heeding your call, enhancing Fox Spirits and Spirit Frenzy.

skills.name: Spirit Bond 4
skills.description: Deepens your bond with the spirits, increasing Ignore Defense and Boss Damage.

skills.name: Advanced Knuckle Mastery
skills.description:
Uses the power of spirits to maximize your Knuckle Mastery.
Permanently increases Final Damage.

skills.name: Spirit Claw - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Spirit Claw's and True Spirit Claw's damage.

skills.name: Spirit Claw - Boss Rush
skills.description: Increases damage when attacking Boss Monsters with Spirit Claw and True Spirit Claw.

skills.name: Spirit Claw - Extra Strike
skills.description: Increases Spirit Claw's and True Spirit Claw's attack count.

skills.name: Bomb Punch - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases Bomb Punch's damage.

skills.name: Bomb Punch - Spread
skills.description: Increases the max number of monsters hit by Bomb Punch.

skills.name: Bomb Punch - Critical Chance
skills.description: Increases Bomb Punch's Critical Rate.

skills.name: Fox Spirits - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the attack power of Fox Spirits and Fox Spirits Orb.

skills.name: Fox Spirits - Repeated Attack Bonus
skills.description: Increases the attack repeat count of Fox Spirits and Fox Spirits Orb.

skills.name: Fox Spirits - Summon Chance
skills.description: Increases the chance of summoning Fox Spirits and Fox Spirits Orb.

skills.name: Critical Insight
skills.description: Increases Critical Rate, Critical Damage, and Final Damage by revealing the holes in your enemies' defense.

skills.name: Bomb Punch
skills.description:
Summons a nature spirit to attack multiple enemies in front of you.
Can be used 3 times in a row.

skills.name: Spirit Claw
skills.description: Summon a wind spirit to claw at multiple enemies.

skills.name: Death Mark
skills.description:
Summons a grim spirit to attack enemies in front of you. Attacked enemies receive Death Marks.
Death Marks deal damage to enemies over time, and you'll absorb a portion of the mark damage as HP.
Death Mark is not affected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Spirit Incarnation
skills.description:
Transmforms you into an incarnated spirit that attacks all nearby enemies ruthlessly.
You become invincible during transformation.

skills.name: Spirit Incarnation
skills.description: Transforms you into an invincible spirit that attacks all nearby enemies ruthlessly.
skills.note: Invisible variant in the skillbook. effect is a blank timing sequence in the WZ (all 1 frames 1x1); omitted from playback.

skills.name: Maple Warrior
skills.description: The Goddess of Maple World's grace increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of Maple World appear.

skills.name: Fox Marble Fusion
skills.description:
Unlocks the Fox Marble's true potential as a conduit for the Fox God's power.
The empowered Fox Marble enhances Fox Spirits to Fox Spirits Orb for a set duration, and also automatically summons the guardian spirit
to create a Spirit Ward.

skills.name: Heroic Memories
skills.description: Recalls the oath of the Maple Heroes to increase damage.

skills.name: Spirit Ward
skills.description: Calls upon guardian spirits to neutralize enemy magic and protect you from harm. Spirit Ward's passive effect is not affected by cooldown resets.

skills.name: Hero's Will
skills.description:
Hones your resolve to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec. after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through. Does not apply Combat Orders.
Can be used while using other skills.

skills.name: Fox God Flash
skills.description:
Incarnates an Avatar of the Fox God, vanquishing darkness with divine light.
Blessed by the Fox God, Shade's skill cooldowns reset, excluding skills that are not affected by cooldown reset effects.
The Avatar of the Fox God enhances Shade's blessing for a set duration, and Foxlight shines down to scour enemies hit by Shade's attacks. Foxlights are not affected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Spiritgate
skills.description:
Throws open a gate to the spirit world with an explosion of energy, followed by Spirits of Darkness that spill out and attack your foes.
Spiritgate is not affected by attack reflection, and the Spirits of Darkness target the boss with the highest HP within range first.

skills.name: Devious Nightmare
skills.description:
A specter's energy that slips out during battle and attacks enemies. Enhanced to Devious Dream during Specter State.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Devious Dream
skills.description:
A specter's energy that slips out during battle and attacks enemies. Changed to Nightmare's Escape during Flora State.
Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Endlessly Starving Beast
skills.description: Summon a ravenous beast from the Abyssal depths and command it to devour everything in its path. From the moment the depths open, there's a certain delay until the beast arrives, but successful use of Specter's Force skills can hasten its arrival. The Endlessly Starving Beast is unaffected by attack ignore and attack reflection.

Unleashes Spirit Energy to do three consecutive straight punches.
Activating Fox Marble Fusion resets this skill's cooldown and progress, allowing it to be used a set number of times without going on cooldown.

skills.name: Advent of the Fox
skills.description:
Attunes the Fox God's power to fully awaken Shade's latent spiritual potential.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +20%
Lv. 20 - Boss Damage: +20%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +30%, Boss Damage: +30%

skills.name: Advent of the Fox

skills.description:
Channels the purest power of the Fox God through the Fox Marble, weakening the boundary separating the spirit world and calling on the spirits to chastise your foes.

Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%

skills.description: Awakens the full martial arts potential of the Fox God sealed in the Fox Marble. Receive the blessing of the Fox God to temporarily increase Final Damage and enhance Spirit Claw, Fox Spirits, and True Spirit Claw into Fox God Claw, Fox Spirits Orb, and Fox God Avatar. True Spirit Claw and Fox God Avatar share a cooldown. Advent of the Fox, Fox Spirits Orb, and Fox God Avatar are unaffected by attack reflection.
